title: Towards ML Methods for Biodiversity: A Novel Wild Bee Dataset and Evaluations of XAI Methods for ML-Assisted Rare Species Annotations
reasoning: The paper focuses on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to assist biologists in annotation tasks and to build trust in ML models for insect monitoring. This is a matter of interpretability and reliability in a scientific context, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics itself.
